source: public requirements and own generated tests only
public_contract: Separate eligible and blocked Open PRs; eligible has current non-author approval, successful test check, no conflicts; each seed state is restored independently before reuse; any valid Request changes blocks merging.

own_suite.problem: Both use the same seeded Open PR. The Request changes test preserves its decision; the later merge test neither restores it nor establishes eligibility before expecting the button enabled.

actual_startup_state.problem: The fresh seed also lacks the stated eligible Open PR; it should not be called eligible merely because it is Open.

controlled_repair.original_ui: 99 pass to 98 pass; REQ-6-5 positive now sees disabled merge
controlled_repair.limits: The lost pass is not evidence that the original behavior was correct. Both seed completeness and test preconditions need calibration; no assertion was weakened and no promotion is claimed.
